prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: alternate character design proposal for RuneNexus heavy tank guardian, moderately LESS ARMORED.
Input: attached image is the original selected heavy guardian proposal 01; treat as identity and proportion reference.
Primary request: make this SAME character wear a little less armor, revealing more natural stone body. This is a moderate armor coverage reduction, not a new character or an unarmored redesign.

Preserve IDENTICALLY: huge squat stone head and stern turquoise eyes, face geometry and expression, short muscular limbs, compact broad torso, chunky gray fists, short stone legs and broad flat stone feet, same overall mass and full-body proportions, same dark cylindrical joint cavities with small brass hinge rims. Keep the exact central forehead/crown ochre-brass helmet plate with ONE recessed turquoise angular spiral rune, keep the small amber round chest core and brass inset rim. Preserve head about one third total height, broad chunky friendly but stern tank silhouette. Natural weathered warm gray-brown granular stone and worn muted ochre-gold/brass material, contained rune glow.

Change ONLY armor COVERAGE: leave the central rune-bearing forehead plate and a short thick brow protection, but uncover most side and rear of head so helmet is lighter. Reduce the original massive FULL SHOULDER SHELLS to two thick small upper OUTER SHOULDER CAPS, each covering just the top/outer third of the shoulder; show rounded chunky bare stone shoulder masses below and inside. Shoulder gold coverage should be about HALF original, shoulder body width stays same because underlying stone remains broad. Reduce broad brass FOREARM CUFFS to short narrow heavy bands near the wrist, showing most thick stone forearms. Keep brass ankle rims and chest core rim. Overall gold armor area about 35 percent less than the original, solid armor thickness maintained; no extra gold added elsewhere. Do not make a thin or frail body, tanker identity remains intact.

Composition: same clean square concept plate as the reference, one dominant uncropped full-body three-quarter view facing lower-left, relaxed closed-fist stance, dark desaturated navy-gray studio ground. One small high-angle inset of THE SAME less-armored variant in upper-right, matching reduced shoulder caps and exposed forearms. Leave breathing room all around. Soft studio key light and restrained fill reveal stone and brass thickness, texture, cracks and joints, soft grounding shadows.
No numbers, text, labels, logo or watermark. No scenery, weapons, floating components, cape, extra runes, wings, new spikes, bright aura, chest redesign, new colors or added mechanics. This must be clearly recognizable as proposal 01 with less armor.
